Six friends — Anaya, Bhavesh, Chirag, Divya, Esha and Farhan — sit in a row of six seats numbered 1 to 6 from left to right. All of them face the same direction.

- Anaya sits at one of the two ends.
- Bhavesh sits exactly two seats to the right of Anaya.
- Divya sits immediately to the right of Chirag.
- Esha sits immediately to the right of Bhavesh.

Answer the questions that follow.
